record.reason: EdgePipe is an inference system for large deep neural networks split across heterogeneous edge devices, but its empirical evaluation focuses on image-classification/computer-vision models including ViT-Base, ViT-Large and ViT-Huge, with throughput measured in images per second. The primary paper does not evaluate LLM or language-model serving, KV state, or text generation. Its generic inference partitioning is outside this LLM-inference candidate scope.
record.title: Pipeline Parallelism for Inference on Heterogeneous Edge Computing
